xlsx.reason: No fixed release exists. Parsing is limited to two authenticated admin imports; upload size/type limits are applied. Replacement with a maintained workbook library is tracked.

glob.reason: Dev-only transitive dependency of jest (devDependency); never loaded by the running API. Fix requires a jest major upgrade, tracked separately.

minimatch.reason: Dev-only transitive dependency of jest and nodemon (devDependencies); not reachable from HTTP request handling. Upstream fixed majors are not compatible with the pinned jest version yet.

react-router.reason: SPA only: no SSR/hydration path, and navigation targets are static application routes rather than user-supplied redirect URLs. Major upgrade to v7 is tracked separately.
